definitions.name: "Welcome to Pokestar!"
definitions.description: `Welcome to Pokestar! Pokestar is a battle-focused Pokemon Discord bot! This tutorial will guide you through the basics of Pokestar. **For more information, please [join the support server](${SUPPORT_SERVER_INVITE}) or use \`/help\` for help with commands!**\n\nHere are some Pokeballs to get you started!`

definitions.name: "Catching Pokemon"
definitions.description: "The first thing to do is catch Pokemon! **To catch new Pokemon, use the `/gacha` command**. \n## `/gacha`"

definitions.name: "Daily Rewards"
definitions.description: "You can get more money and Pokeballs for free every day! **Use `/daily` to claim your daily rewards.** \n## `/daily`"

definitions.name: "Backpack Management"
definitions.description: "You can view your items and money by using `/backpack`. \n## `/backpack`"

definitions.name: "Catch More Pokemon"
definitions.description: "Catch more Pokemon to build your team! **Use `/gacha` to catch 6 Pokemon**.\n## `/gacha`"

definitions.name: "Building Your Party"
definitions.description: "Build your party by adding 6 Pokemon to your party! **Use `/party auto` to add your 6 strongest Pokemon to your party**. You can also use `/party manage` to make finer adjustments to your party. \n## `/party auto` `/party manage`"

definitions.name: "Learning to Battle: Taking Turns"
definitions.description: "Before you battle, you must learn how they work! Battles in Pokestar are unique; **all 6 Pokemon fight at a time!**\n\n**Taking turns is based off combat readiness.** Pokemon with higher speed gain combat readiness faster. The current active Pokemon is highlighted in asterisks."

definitions.name: "Learning to Battle: Using Moves"
definitions.description: "When its your turn, you can use a move! **Use the dropdown menu to select a move.**\n\nWhen selecting a move, a description will appear. This includes important move information such as its **type, power, effect, and cooldown.**"

definitions.name: "Learning to Battle: Selecting Targets"
definitions.description:
"When using a move, you must select a target! **Click on the Pokemon you want to target from the dropdown menu.** Most moves may only target certain Pokemon, which is indicated in the **Target:** section of the move description." +
      "

**Some moves may affect an area of Pokemon.** When a target is selected, that area is indicated by a wider border. **When satisfied, click the ⚔️ Confirm button to use the move.**" +
      "

For more detailed battle mechanics, check out the [documentation on Github](https://github.com/ewei068/pokestar?tab=readme-ov-file#-battle-mechanics)."

definitions.name: "Battle an NPC!"
definitions.description: "Now that you know how to battle, **use `/pve` to battle an NPC!** I'd recommend starting with the <:bugcatcher:1117871382399815812> Bug Catcher on Very Easy difficulty. \n## `/pve`"

definitions.name: "Buying Pokeballs"
definitions.description: `One of the best ways to get more Pokeballs is to buy them from the Pokemart every day. Use \`/pokemart\` to buy ${emojis.POKEBALL} Pokeballs, or use \`/buy itemid: 0 quantity: 5\` to buy the maximum amount.\n## \`/pokemart\``

definitions.name: "Viewing Pokemon: List"
definitions.description: "You can view all your Pokemon using `/list`. **Use `/list` to view your Pokemon.** \n## `/list`"

definitions.name: "Viewing Pokemon: Info"
definitions.description: "You can view a specific Pokemon using `/info`, or clicking them from the `/list` dropdown menu. **Use `/info` to view a specific Pokemon.**\n## `/info <name>`"

definitions.name: "Training Pokemon"
definitions.description: "One way to give your Pokemon more EXP is by training! Copy a Pokemon's ID, then **Use `/train` to train a Pokemon to level 12.**\n## `/train <id>`"

definitions.name: "Viewing Trainer Info"
definitions.description: "You can view your trainer info using `/trainerinfo`. **Use `/trainerinfo` to view your trainer info.** \n## `/trainerinfo`"

definitions.name: "Trainer Level"
definitions.description: "In your trainer info, you may notice a trainer level. **Leveling your trainer makes your Pokemon gain more EXP.**\n\nMost commands and actions will provide your trainer EXP. **Reach trainer level 3.**"

definitions.name: "Level Rewards"
definitions.description: "Every time you level up, you gain level rewards! **Use `/levelrewards` to claim your level rewards.** \n## `/levelrewards`"

definitions.name: "Purchasing Locations"
definitions.description: "You may purchase and upgrade locations from the `/pokemart` for permanent boosts! **Use `/pokemart` to purchase the 🏠 Home location and upgrade it to level 3.** The Home locations improves the EXP gained from `/train`!\n## `/pokemart`"

definitions.name: "Beginner Pokemon Leveling"
definitions.description: "Now that you can `/train` your Pokemon faster, **train 6 Pokemon to level 15.**\n\nTip: On desktop, you can use the Up Arrow key to use your last command."

definitions.name: "Win Easy Difficulty"
definitions.description: "Now that you have trained your Pokemon, **use `/pve` to win a battle on Easy difficulty.**\n\nFrom now on, **Battling is the most efficient way to gain EXP.**"

definitions.name: "Quests"
definitions.description: "Quests are another way to get **daily and one-time rewards.** Use `/quest` to view and complete quests. \n## `/quest`"

definitions.name: "Events"
definitions.description: "Pokestar has events which provide **limited-time rewards, benefits, and custom Pokemon!** Use `/events` to view ongoing events. \n## `/events`"

definitions.name: "(Optional) Voting"
definitions.description:
"Voting for Pokestar helps the bot grow! **Vote for Pokestar on top.gg [here](https://top.gg/bot/1093411444877439066/vote)**. Then, use `/vote` to claim your rewards.\n\n" +
      `Voting gives you many rewards, and voting consistently gives you a streak. Voting gives you **💵 Pokedollars, ${emojis.POKEBALL} Pokeballs, and tons of items!**`

definitions.name: "Settings"
definitions.description:
"You can view and change your settings using `/settings`. **Use `/settings` to view and change your settings.**

If you're getting the hang of battles, you can speed them up by disabling target indicators. You can also set your device type to mobile for mobile optimizations. 
## `/settings`"

definitions.name: "Intermediate Pokemon Leveling"
definitions.description: "Now that you can win battles, use `/pve` to **train 6 Pokemon to level 30.**"

definitions.name: "Evolving Pokemon"
definitions.description: "Some Pokemon can evolve at the right level! Use `/pokedex` and click the growth tab to know when a Pokemon evolves, then **use `/evolve` to evolve a Pokemon.** \n## `/pokedex <name>` `/evolve <name>`"

definitions.name: "Win Medium Difficulty"
definitions.description: "Now that you have evolved your Pokemon, **use `/pve` to win a battle on Medium difficulty.** \n## `/pve`"

definitions.name: "Catching More Pokemon"
definitions.description: "You should keep using the `/gacha` to catch strong Pokemon. **Catch 50 Pokemon.** \n## `/gacha`"

definitions.name: "Catching Darkrai"
definitions.description: "Darkrai is a Mythical Pokemon that can be caught after **completing 25 tutorial stages.** Use **`/mythic darkrai`** to catch Darkrai! \n## `/mythic darkrai`"

definitions.name: "Auto Battle"
definitions.description: `Darkrai allows you to **auto-battle** in most PvE content! Auto-battling consumes ${emojis.DREAM_CARD} Dream Cards, which recharges once every 5 minutes.\n\nUse \`/pve\` to start a battle, then **press the Auto button** to start an auto-battle.`

definitions.name: "Advanced Pokemon Leveling"
definitions.description: "Now that you have caught more Pokemon, **train 6 Pokemon to level 50.**\n\n**More difficult trainers provide more EXP!**"

definitions.name: "Win Hard Difficulty"
definitions.description: "Now that you have trained your Pokemon, **use `/pve` to win a battle on Hard difficulty.**"

definitions.name: "Battle Tower"
definitions.description: "The Battle Tower is a challenging mid-to-end-game location that provides many rewards. **Use `/battletower` to view and defeat at least one level of the Battle Tower.**\n\nThe Battle Tower's rewards **reset every other week!** Make sure to come back for tons of Pokeballs and items!"

definitions.name: "Elite Pokemon Leveling"
definitions.description: "Now that you have taken on the Battle Tower, **train 6 Pokemon to level 75.**"

definitions.name: "Win Very Hard Difficulty"
definitions.description: "Now that you have trained your Pokemon to be very strong, **use `/pve` to win a battle on Very Hard difficulty.**"

definitions.name: "(Optional) PvP Battles"
definitions.description: "You're getting pretty strong now; maybe it's time to take on another trainer! PvP battles are battles against other players; **you can use `/pvp` to battle another player.**"

definitions.name: "Leaderboards"
definitions.description: "You're starting to become an elite trainer! **Use `/leaderboards` to view the leaderboards.** Are you on top?"

definitions.name: "Maximum Pokemon Leveling"
definitions.description: "Now that you have won many battles, **train 6 Pokemon to level 100.** The maximum level for Pokemon from training is 100.\n\nRemember, **more difficult trainers provide more EXP!**"

definitions.name: "EV Training: Locations"
definitions.description: "You can train your Pokemon's EVs at the EV Training locations. **Use `/pokemart` to purchase the Track location and upgrade it to level 3.** The Track location trains Speed EVs."

definitions.name: "EV Training: Training"
definitions.description: "Now that you have the Track location, **use `/train pokemonid: {pokemon id} location: track` to train a Pokemon's Speed EVs.**\n\nPokemon can have a maximum of 510 total EVs, and 252 EVs in one stat. **Use `/info` to view a Pokemon's EVs.**"

definitions.name: "Dungeons: Beat New Island"
definitions.description: "Dungeons are end-game content that provide materials to further train your Pokemon. Beating the New Island dungeon for the first time provides the **Mythical Mew. Use `/dungeons` to view and defeat New Island.**"

definitions.name: "Catching Mythical Mew"
definitions.description: "Now that you have defeated New Island, you can catch the Mythical Mew! **Use `/mythic mew` to catch the Mythical Mew.**\n\nMew is a powerful Pokemon who can learn many different moves!"

definitions.name: "Tutorial Complete!"
definitions.description: `Congratulations! You have completed the tutorial! You are now ready to explore the world of Pokestar! **For more information, please [join the support server](${SUPPORT_SERVER_INVITE}) or use \`/help\` for help with commands!**`

definitions.name: "Horn Attack"
definitions.description: "The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage."

definitions.name: "Tackle"
definitions.description: "A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole ass body."

definitions.name: "Body Slam"
definitions.description: "The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This has a 30% chance to leave the target with paralysis."

definitions.name: "Groggy Slam"
definitions.description: "The user rolls over in its slumber, dropping onto targets with its full body weight. This has a 30% chance to leave the targets with paralysis."

definitions.name: "Wrap"
definitions.description: "The target is wrapped in thin, sharp vines to inflict damage over time for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Take Down"
definitions.description: "A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user by a fourth of the damage dealt."

definitions.name: "Double-Edge"
definitions.description: "A reckless, life-risking tackle. This also damages the user by a third of the damage dealt."

definitions.name: "Poison Sting"
definitions.description: "The target is stabbed with a toxic barb, poisoning with a 75% chance."

definitions.name: "Leer"
definitions.description: "The targets are stared down with intimidating eyes, lowering their defense for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Roar"
definitions.description: "The target is scared off, fully reducing its combat readiness and removing all buffs."

definitions.name: "Sing"
definitions.description: "A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts targets into a deep slumber."

definitions.name: "Disable"
definitions.description: "Disables the target's ultimate move for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Acid"
definitions.description: "The target is sprayed with a harsh, dissolving acid that has a 20% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Ember"
definitions.description: "The target is attacked with small flames. This has a 20% chance to leave the target with a burn."

definitions.name: "Flamethrower"
definitions.description: "The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This has a 20% chance to leave targets with a burn."

definitions.name: "Water Gun"
definitions.description: "The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water."

definitions.name: "Hydro Pump"
definitions.description: "The target row is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure, reducing their combat readiness by 15%."

definitions.name: "Hydro Artilery Pump"
definitions.description: "The target area is blasted by a huge volume of water launched precisely under great pressure, reducing their combat readiness by 15%. This move is 1.5x effective if there's only one target."

definitions.name: "Holy Pump"
definitions.description: "The target row is blasted by a huge volume of holy energy, reducing their attack and special attack for 1 turn. Effects apply even if the attack misses."

definitions.name: "Surf"
definitions.description: "All enemies are hit by a huge wave. Has 5 less base power for each additional enemy targetted (not including the first)."

definitions.name: "Ice Beam"
definitions.description: "The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This has a 25% chance to freeze the targets."

definitions.name: "Blizzard"
definitions.description: "A howling blizzard is summoned to strike all enemies. This has a 30% chance to freeze the targets."

definitions.name: "Psybeam"
definitions.description: "The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This has a 50% chance to confuse the target for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Hyper Beam"
definitions.description: "The target is attacked with a powerful beam. This does 50% damage to non-primary targets. The user must rest on the next turn."

definitions.name: "Peck"
definitions.description: "The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn."

definitions.name: "Drill Peck"
definitions.description: "The target is repeatedly jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn."

definitions.name: "Counter"
definitions.description: "The user assumes a countering stance for 2 turns. When damaged by a physical move, the user retaliates with a physical attack 1.5x the power."

definitions.name: "Strength"
definitions.description: "The target is attacked with a powerful blow. This deals a small amount of additional true damage based on user's attack."

definitions.name: "Absorb"
definitions.description: "The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. The user gains 50% of the damage dealt as HP."

definitions.name: "Leech Seed"
definitions.description: "A seed is planted on the target for 5 turns. It steals 1/4 of the target's max HP every turn."

definitions.name: "Solar Beam"
definitions.description: "A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn."

definitions.name: "Poison Powder"
definitions.description: "The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust on the target, poisoning the target."

definitions.name: "Sleep Powder"
definitions.description: "The user scatters a big cloud of sleep-inducing dust around the target."

definitions.name: "String Shot"
definitions.description: "The target is sprayed with a sticky string that lowers their combat readiness by 30% and sharply lowers their speed for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Thunder Shock"
definitions.description: "A jolt of electricity is hurled at the target to inflict damage. This has a 10% chance to paralyze the target."

definitions.name: "Thunderbolt"
definitions.description: "A strong electric blast is loosed at the target. This has a 25% chance to paralyze the target."

definitions.name: "Thunder Wave"
definitions.description: "A weak electric charge is launched at the target row, paralyzing them. If the user is electric type and the opponent isn't ground type, will paralyze the primary target regardless of missing."

definitions.name: "Thunder"
definitions.description: "A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This has a 30% chance to paralyze targets."

definitions.name: "Thunder Charge"
definitions.description: "The user charges a wicked thunderbolt to be dropped on the target. The user suffers decreased speed for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Rock Throw"
definitions.description: "The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to inflict damage."

definitions.name: "Earthquake"
definitions.description: "The user sets off an earthquake that hits all enemy Pokemon. Has 7 less base power for each additional enemy targetted (not including the first)."

definitions.name: "Dig"
definitions.description: "The user burrows into the ground, becoming untargetable and unhittable 1 turn. The user then attacks on the next turn."

definitions.name: "Toxic"
definitions.description: "A move that leaves the targets badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn. If the user is Poison type and the target isn't Steel type, ignore miss on the primary target."

definitions.name: "Agility"
definitions.description: "The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the user's Speed for 5 turns and boosts combat readiness by 80%."

definitions.name: "Ifrit Jambe"
definitions.description: "The user rapidly spins its body to move blazingly fast. This raises the user's Attack and Speed for 4 turns and boosts combat readiness by 80%. If the user isn't Fire type, permanently change its secondary type to Fire."

definitions.name: "Quick Attack"
definitions.description: "The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. Also boosts the user's combat readiness by 30%."

definitions.name: "Teleport"
definitions.description: "The user teleports away, boosting the ally with the most combat readiness by 60 combat readiness."

definitions.name: "Night Shade"
definitions.description: "The user attacks the target with a shadowy blob. The damage dealt is equal to 1.5x the user's level."

definitions.name: "Mimic"
definitions.description: "The user copies the target's ultimate move for 3 turns, then gain 50% combat readiness. Fails if the target has no ultimate move. If the user doesn't know mimic, replaces the move in the first slot."

definitions.name: "Screech"
definitions.description: "The user emits a screech harsh enough to sharply lower the targets' Defense for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Recover"
definitions.description: "The user recovers 50% of its max HP."

definitions.name: "Harden"
definitions.description: "The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense for 2 turns. Also gains 15% def as shield."

definitions.name: "Smokescreen"
definitions.description: "The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This sharply lowers the targets' Accuracy for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Rocket Smokescreen"
definitions.description: "The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This sharply raises allies' evasion for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Withdraw"
definitions.description: "The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense for 2 turns and gaining 15% defense as shield."

definitions.name: "Defense Curl"
definitions.description: "The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense for 4 turns and boost the power of Rollout. Also gains 10% defense as shield."

definitions.name: "Light Screen"
definitions.description: "The user creates a wall of light, sharply raising the Special Defense of targeted allies for 3 turns, and raising the Special Defense of other allies."

definitions.name: "Reflect"
definitions.description: "The user creates a wall of light, sharply raising the Defense of targeted allies for 3 turns, and raising the Defense of other allies."

definitions.name: "Focus Energy"
definitions.description: "The user takes a deep breath and focuses, sharply raising the user's attack and special attack for 1 turn and gaining 50% combat readiness."

definitions.name: "Metronome"
definitions.description: "The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using any basic move."

definitions.name: "Lick"
definitions.description: "The user licks the target with its tongue, dealing damage and having a 30% to paralyze it."

definitions.name: "Smog"
definitions.description: "The user emits a cloud of poison gas. This may also poison the target with a 50% chance."

definitions.name: "Fire Blast"
definitions.description: "The user launches a huge fireball at the target. This may also burn targets with a 30% chance."

definitions.name: "Waterfall"
definitions.description: "The user charges at the target and may make it flinch with 20% chance. This chance increases in proportion to how much more attack the user has compared to the target."

definitions.name: "Kinesis"
definitions.description: "The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target's accuracy for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Soft-Boiled"
definitions.description: "The user sacrifices 10% of its HP to heal the target by 50% of the user's max HP. If the target is fully healed, reduce this cooldown by 1."

definitions.name: "High Jump Kick"
definitions.description: "The user jumps high into the air and slams down on the target. If the user misses, it takes 50% damage as recoil."

definitions.name: "Glare"
definitions.description: "The user glares at the target, paralyzing it. Grants the user 80% combat readiness."

definitions.name: "Rocket Glare"
definitions.description: "The user glares at the targets, paralyzing those hit."

definitions.name: "Sky Attack"
definitions.description: "A second-turn attack move. If this defeats the target, all enemies have a 30% chance to flinch, boosted by 10% of the user's speed, up to a max of 75%."

definitions.name: "Spore"
definitions.description: "The user scatters bursts of spores that can't miss and cause the target to fall asleep."

definitions.name: "Splash"
definitions.description: "The user flops and splashes around to no effect at all..."

definitions.name: "Crabhammer"
definitions.description: "The user attacks the target column with its pincers. If hit, deals a small amount of true damage proportional to the user's attack."

definitions.name: "Explosion"
definitions.description: "The user explodes, dealing damage to enemies. This also deals 1/3rd damage to surrounding allies, and causes the user to faint. Power increases proportional to percent remaining HP."

definitions.name: "Paws of Fury"
definitions.description: "The user attacks the target square with its paws like it attacks trucks. This attack hits twice; the first lowering defense for 1 turn and the second dealing double damage."

definitions.name: "Rest"
definitions.description: "The user goes to sleep. This fully restores the user's HP and removes all status effects and debuffs. Fails if the user is already asleep or at max HP"

definitions.name: "Rock Slide"
definitions.description: "Large boulders are hurled at the target to inflict damage. This also has a 70% chance to make the target flinch for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Super Fang"
definitions.description: "The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This deals damage equal to 50% of the target's current HP and can't miss."

definitions.name: "Triple Kick"
definitions.description: "A consecutive spinning three-kick attack. Deals damage 3 times."

definitions.name: "Thief"
definitions.description: "The user attacks and steals the target's buffs simultaneously."

definitions.name: "Flail"
definitions.description: "The user flails about aimlessly to attack. This move's power increases the lower the user's HP."

definitions.name: "Aeroblast"
definitions.description: "A vortex of air is shot to inflict damage. This only deals most damage to up to 3 random targets in the area, deals extra true damage proportional to the user's HP to any targets hit."

definitions.name: "Shadowblast"
definitions.description: "A vortex of dark energy is shot to inflict damage. If hit, always super effective."

definitions.name: "Protect"
definitions.description: "The user becomes invulnerable to moves, statuses, and debuffs for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Stretchy Defense"
definitions.description: "The user becomes invulnerable to moves for 1 turn. If hit by Physical attacks, the user stretches its body to the shape of the attack, healing what damage it would have taken. If hit by a Special attack, the user reflects the attack."

definitions.name: "Mach Punch"
definitions.description: "The user throws a punch at blinding speed, increasing the user's combat readiness by 30%."

definitions.name: "Mach Pistol"
definitions.description: "The user stretches its arm back, then throws a punch at blinding speed, increasing the user's combat readiness by 40%."

definitions.name: "Sweet Kiss"
definitions.description: "The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Belly Drum"
definitions.description: "The user permanently doubles its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP. Then, gain another turn."

definitions.name: "Sludge Bomb"
definitions.description: "Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This has a 30% poison the targets."

definitions.name: "Mud Slap"
definitions.description: "The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Spikes"
definitions.description: "The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team's feet. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon that have their combat readiness boosted and before they move."

definitions.name: "Zap Cannon"
definitions.description: "The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and paralyze the target if hit."

definitions.name: "Destiny Bond"
definitions.description: "The user enters in to a dark pact with the target. If the user faints in the next turn, the target Pokemon also faints."

definitions.name: "Perish Song"
definitions.description: "The user sings an ancient song that causes targets AND surrounding allies to faint in 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Lock-On"
definitions.description: "The user takes aim at the target, forcing them to redirect moves and sharply reducing their evasion for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Outrage"
definitions.description: "The user rampages and attacks randomly for 3 turns. The user then becomes confused for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Giga Drain"
definitions.description: "A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target."

definitions.name: "Endure"
definitions.description: "Applies Immortality to the user for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Charm"
definitions.description: "The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This sharply lowers the target's attack stat for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Rollout"
definitions.description: "The user continually rolls into the target. If it hits, the next turn's rollout has base 100 power."

definitions.name: "Milk Drink"
definitions.description: "The user restores the target by 40% of the user's max HP, as well as cleansing all debuffs and status conditions. Increases healing by 10% for each effect cleansed."

definitions.name: "Shuron Hakke"
definitions.description: "By consuming a strange liquid substance, the user raises all its stats for 1 turn and restors 25% of its max HP."

definitions.name: "Fury Cutter"
definitions.description: "The target is slashed with scythes or claws. If it hits, the next turn's fury cutter has base 100 power."

definitions.name: "Mean Look"
definitions.description: "The user pins targets with a dark, arresting look. Enemies lose 50% combat readiness and can't gain boosted combat readiness for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Slow Down!"
definitions.description: "The causes enemies to slow to a crawl, sharply reducing their speed for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Sleep Talk"
definitions.description: "The user talks in its sleep, using a random other move against a random target. Ignores cooldowns and missing. Fails if the user is not asleep."

definitions.name: "Heal Bell"
definitions.description: "The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status conditions of all the party Pokémon. Also heals targets for 10% of their max HP, boosted to 20% if a condition is removed."

definitions.name: "Return"
definitions.description: "The user attacks with a happy burst of energy. Has 20 less base power if user is damaged."

definitions.name: "Safeguard"
definitions.description: "The user creates a protective field that prevents allies from receiving status conditions for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Sacred Fire"
definitions.description: "The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. This only damages up to 3 random targets in the area, but has a 50% chance of burning all targets."

definitions.name: "Dynamic Punch"
definitions.description: "The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. If hit, this also confuses surrounding targets for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Megahorn"
definitions.description: "Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup."

definitions.name: "Baton Pass"
definitions.description: "The user boosts an ally's combat readiness to 100%, passing along ALL dispellable effects."

definitions.name: "Attack Cuisine"
definitions.description: "The user prepares a delicious meal for an ally, their combat readiness to 100% and giving them sharply increased Attack and Defense for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Rapid Spin"
definitions.description: "A spin attack that can also dispells debuffs from the user and surrounding allies."

definitions.name: "Iron Tail"
definitions.description: "The user slams the target with its steel-hard tail lowering the target's Defense stat for 2 turns. If the user has higher defense than the target, the effect occurs before damage is dealt."

definitions.name: "Synthesis"
definitions.description: "The user restores its own HP by 33% and gain 50% combat readiness. In sun, boost the users Special Attack and Special Defense for 3 turns. In other weather, this restores 25% HP."

definitions.name: "Moonlight"
definitions.description: "The user restores its own HP by 50%. In sun, this restores 66% HP. In other weather, this restores 25% HP"

definitions.name: "Cross Chop"
definitions.description: "The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. Deals half damage to non-primary targets."

definitions.name: "Twister"
definitions.description: "The user whips up a vicious twister to tear at the opposing team. This may also make the target flinch with a 30% chance."

definitions.name: "Rain Dance"
definitions.description: "The user summons a heavy rain, powering up Water-type moves. Then gains 50% combat readiness."

definitions.name: "Sunny Day"
definitions.description: "The user intensifies the sun, powering up Fire-type moves. Then gains 50% combat readiness."

definitions.name: "Crunch"
definitions.description: "The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's defense for 3 turns with a 85% chance."

definitions.name: "Mirror Coat"
definitions.description: "The user creates a reflective field for 2 turns. When damaged by a Special move, deals damage back to the target with 1.5x base power."

definitions.name: "Extreme Speed"
definitions.description: "The user charges the target at blinding speed, raising the user's combat readiness by 80%."

definitions.name: "Ancient Power"
definitions.description: "The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This has a 50% chance to raise the user's highest non-hp base stat for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Shadow Ball"
definitions.description: "The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat for 3 turns with a 85% chance."

definitions.name: "Future Sight"
definitions.description: "Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks targets. If the Future Sight debuff is cleansed early, deals less damage."

definitions.name: "Rock Smash"
definitions.description: "The user smashes into the target with a rock-hard fist. This may also lower the target's defense for 2 turns with a 70% chance."

definitions.name: "Fake Out"
definitions.description: "The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity, causing the target to flinch for 1 turn. Also boosts the user's combat readiness by 60%."

definitions.name: "Hail"
definitions.description: "The user summons a vicious hailstorm. The user also gains 50% combat readiness."

definitions.name: "Memento"
definitions.description: "The user faints, but sharply lowers the enemy teams' Attack and Special Attack for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Follow Me"
definitions.description: "The user redirects all enemy attacks to itself and gains increased defenses for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Charge"
definitions.description: "The user boosts its Special Defense and Electric moves for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Taunt"
definitions.description: "The user taunts the target into only using moves with base power for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Reverse Taunt"
definitions.description: "The user taunts the target into only using moves WITHOUT base power for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Helping Hand"
definitions.description: "The user assists an ally by boosting their attacking stats for 1 turn, and their combat readiness by 25%."

definitions.name: "Wish"
definitions.description: "The user makes a wish to heal an ally for 50% of the user's max HP after 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Superpower"
definitions.description: "The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Yawn"
definitions.description: "The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls targets into falling asleep in 1 turn. If the user is asleep, apply sleep immediately."

definitions.name: "Knock Off"
definitions.description: "The user slaps down the target, removing all buffs and its item. For each buff or item removed, deals 25% more damage, up to 100% more damage."

definitions.name: "Endeavor"
definitions.description: "An attack move that cuts down the target's HP to equal the user's HP."

definitions.name: "Eruption"
definitions.description: "The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The power of this move decreases proportional to HP lost."

definitions.name: "Grudge"
definitions.description: "If the user faints in the next turn, silence all enemies for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Luster Purge"
definitions.description: "The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def for 2 turns. If an ally has Mist Ball on cooldown, this hits all enemies and ignores miss."

definitions.name: "Mist Ball"
definitions.description: "The user creates a misty explosion around the target. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk for 1 turn. If an ally has Luster Purge on cooldown, instead lower Atk and Sp. Atk for 2 turns, and ignore miss."

definitions.name: "Blaze Kick"
definitions.description: "The user launches a fiery kick that leaves the target with a burn."

definitions.name: "Slack Off"
definitions.description: "The user slacks off, restoring 50% of its max HP and increasing its defense for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Hyper Voice"
definitions.description: "The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage. Deals addtional true damage to all hit targets proportional to the user's special attack and HP."

definitions.name: "Poison Fang"
definitions.description: "The user bites the target with toxic fangs. This may also leave the target badly poisoned with a 75% chance."

definitions.name: "Meteor Mash"
definitions.description: "The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. This also raises the users attack for 2 turns before attacking. If the target doesn't faint, remove the buff."

definitions.name: "Weather Ball"
definitions.description: "This move's type changes depending on the weather, and power is doubled in any weather."

definitions.name: "Aromatherapy"
definitions.description: "The user releases a soothing scent that heals all allies by 25% HP, removing status conditions and debuffs."

definitions.name: "Rock Tomb"
definitions.description: "Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Holy Tomb"
definitions.description: "Boulders of biblical proportion are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat for 2 turns, even when the attack misses."

definitions.name: "Cosmic Power"
definitions.description: "The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its defense and special defense for 3 turns. Gives itself 10% of its defenses as a shield."

definitions.name: "Shadow Punch"
definitions.description: "The user throws a punch from the shadows. This move never misses."

definitions.name: "Muddy Water"
definitions.description: "The user attacks by shooting a wave of muddy water at the opposing team. This may also lower their accuracy and evasionfor 2 turns with a 50% chance."

definitions.name: "Bullet Seed"
definitions.description: "The user forcefully shoots seeds at random targets, hitting 5 times."

definitions.name: "Ashura Bakkei"
definitions.description: "The user takes a turn to charge up, then forcefully slashes at random targets, hitting 9 times. Targets who are successfully hit take an additional 5% max HP true damage."

definitions.name: "Aerial Ace"
definitions.description: "The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses."

definitions.name: "Iron Defense"
definitions.description: "The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat for 3 turns and gaining 15% defense as shield."

definitions.name: "Titanium Defense"
definitions.description: "The user hardens its teammates' bodies like titanium, sharply raising its Defense stat for 2 turns and raising surrounding allies Defense stat for 2 turns. Gives itself 20% defense as shield and allies 5% user def as shield."

definitions.name: "Genetic Defense"
definitions.description: "The user hardens its genetic code and experimental armor, sacrificing speed but sharply raising its Defense and Special Defense for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Howl"
definitions.description: "The user howls loudly to raise the spirit of itself and its allies, boosting their combat readiness by 15% and raising Attack for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Bounce"
definitions.description: "The user bounces up high, then drops on the target on the second turn. This has a 30% chance to leave the target with paralysis."

definitions.name: "Volt Tackle"
definitions.description: "The user electrifies itself, then charges. This also damages the user by 25% of the damage dealt. This may leave the target with paralysis with a 20% chance."

definitions.name: "Calm Mind"
definitions.description: "The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Special Attack and Special Defense for 3 turns and gaining 50% combat readiness."

definitions.name: "Leaf Blade"
definitions.description: "The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. Deals extra true damage based on attack, and only deals 50% damage to other targets."

definitions.name: "Dragon Dance"
definitions.description: "The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that raises its Attack and Speed stats for 3 turns and gaining 50% combat readiness."

definitions.name: "Water Pulse"
definitions.description: "The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This has a 40% chance to confuse targets for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Psycho Boost"
definitions.description: "The user enhances its allies with alien power, sharply raising their highest stat for 2 turns. Then, attacks all enemies."

definitions.name: "Psycho Boost - Attack"
definitions.description: "The user performs an all-out attack, dealing damage based on the higher of its attacking stats, then sharply lowers that stat for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Psycho Boost - Defense"
definitions.description: "The user protects an ally, granting them a shield equal to to 25% of the user's defenses for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Psycho Boost - Speed"
definitions.description: "The user warps time and space at light speed, giving itself 2 additional turns."

definitions.name: "Roost"
definitions.description: "The user lands and rests its body, removing its Flying type for one turn. It restores the user's HP by up to half of its max HP."

definitions.name: "Hammer Arm"
definitions.description: "The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. This lowers the user's Speed for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Healing Wish"
definitions.description: "The user faints and the target Pokemon has their health and combat readiness entirely restored."

definitions.name: "Tailwind"
definitions.description: "The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that sharply raises the Speed of all party Pokémon for 2 turns and boosting combat readiness of the target row by 15%."

definitions.name: "U-Turn"
definitions.description: "After making its attack, the user rushes back, boosting a random party Pokemon's combat readiness to max."

definitions.name: "Close Combat"
definitions.description: "The user fights the target up close without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Gattling Combat"
definitions.description: "The user moves horizontally in a rapid fashion, sretching its fists to attack rapidly. This also sharply lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Last Resort"
definitions.description: "The user attacks the target with full force. This move has 40 additional base power for each additional move on cooldown."

definitions.name: "Aqua Ring"
definitions.description: "The user envelops allies in a veil made of water, restoring 18% of the user's max HP for 3 turns and boosting defense for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Flare Blitz"
definitions.description: "The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target, and damaging it and dealing 50% damage to adjacent targets. This also damages the user by a third of the damage dealt, and has a 10% chance to leave targets with a burn."

definitions.name: "Dark Blitz"
definitions.description: "The user cloaks itself in sinister flames and charges at the target. Type effectiveness is calculated as the best of Fire and Dark. This also damages the user by a third of the damage dealt."

definitions.name: "Aura Sphere"
definitions.description: "The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This move never misses."

definitions.name: "Poison Jab"
definitions.description: "The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This has a 80% chance to poison the target."

definitions.name: "Dark Pulse"
definitions.description: "The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. This has a 25% chance to flinch targets for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Seed Bomb"
definitions.description: "The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above. Adjacent targets take 50% damage."

definitions.name: "X-Scissor"
definitions.description: "The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors. The primary target is hit a second time with an attack that deals 2x damage."

definitions.name: "Bug Buzz"
definitions.description: "The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This also has a 80% chance to lower targets Sp. Defense for two turns BEFORE dealing damage."

definitions.name: "Dragon Pulse"
definitions.description: "The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth."

definitions.name: "Dragon Rush"
definitions.description: "The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This also has a 30% chance to make the target flinch for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Drain Punch"
definitions.description: "An energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target."

definitions.name: "Energy Ball"
definitions.description: "The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This has a 85% chance to lower the target's Sp. Defense for 4 turn."

definitions.name: "Brave Bird"
definitions.description: "The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. This also damages the user by a third of the damage dealt."

definitions.name: "Earth Power"
definitions.description: "The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This also has a 30% chance to lower targets' Sp. Defense for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Giga Impact"
definitions.description: "The user charges at the target using every bit of its power, dealing damage to the primary target and 50% damage to other targets. The user must rest on the next turn."

definitions.name: "Galaxy Impact"
definitions.description: "The launches an attack at the target using every bit of its willpower, dealing damage to the primary target and 50% damage to other targets. The user's speed is greatly lowered for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Nasty Plot"
definitions.description: "The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply raises the user's Sp. Attack stat for 5 turns, and gives it 60% combat readiness."

definitions.name: "Uncontrollable Joy"
definitions.description: "The user stimulates the an ally's brain by thinking happy thoughts. This sharply raises the target's Sp. Attack and Evasion for 2 turns, and gives it 60% combat readiness."

definitions.name: "Bullet Punch"
definitions.description: "The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets, dealing damage and increasing its own combat readiness by 30%."

definitions.name: "Ice Shard"
definitions.description: "The user launches sharp icicles at the target, dealing damage and increasing its own combat readiness by 30%."

definitions.name: "Fire Fang"
definitions.description: "The user bites the target with flame-cloaked fangs, dealing damage and has a 25% chance to flinch and 25% chance to leave the target with a burn."

definitions.name: "Shadow Sneak"
definitions.description: "The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This deals damage and increases the user's combat readiness by 30%."

definitions.name: "Zen Headbutt"
definitions.description: "The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This also causes the target to flinch for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Flash Cannon"
definitions.description: "The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once, dealing damage and has a 40% chance to lower targets Sp. Defense for two turns."

definitions.name: "Defog"
definitions.description: "The user blows a powerful gust that dispells buffs from enemies and debuffs from allies."

definitions.name: "Trick Room"
definitions.description: "The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokemon recieve speed buffs or debuffs inversely based on how fast they are for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Discharge"
definitions.description: "The user fires a powerful electric blast at the target, dealing damage and has a 35% chance to paralyze targets."

definitions.name: "Volt Discharge"
definitions.description: "The user discharges its debuffs as a powerful electric blast at the target, dealing damage and transferring one dispellable debuff per-target."

definitions.name: "Leaf Storm"
definitions.description: "The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target, dealing damage and sharply lowers the user's Sp. Attack for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Gunk Shot"
definitions.description: "The user fires a filthy shot at the target to inflict damage and has a 50% chance to poison targets. If already poisoned, deals 1.5x damage."

definitions.name: "Stone Edge"
definitions.description: "The user stabs the target column with sharpened stones from below."

definitions.name: "Stealth Rock"
definitions.description: "The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the target for 5 turns. The trap hurts opposing Pokemon that have their combat readiness boosted or receive buffs."

definitions.name: "Aqua Jet"
definitions.description: "The user charges at the target with blinding speed, dealing damage and raising the user's combat readiness by 30%."

definitions.name: "Wide Guard"
definitions.description: "The user and its allies take 30% less damage, increased to 60% damage from non-single-target attacks for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Rage Powder"
definitions.description: "The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself and raise its defenses. Enemies can only attack the user for a turn."

definitions.name: "Smack Down"
definitions.description: "The user throws a stone or projectile to the target, dealing damage and knocking the target to the ground. Able to hit flying targets."

definitions.name: "Sludge Wave"
definitions.description: "The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This only deals damage to the target row, but has a 50% of poisoning all targets."

definitions.name: "Quiver Dance"
definitions.description: "The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stats for 4 turns. Boost the user's combat readiness by 50%."

definitions.name: "Heavy Slam"
definitions.description: "The user slams into the target with its heavy body. Power increases in proportion to how slow the user is and user max HP."

definitions.name: "Foul Play"
definitions.description: "The user attacks the target using the target's own power. Calculates damage using the target's attack stat."

definitions.name: "Scald"
definitions.description: "The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn with a 75% chance."

definitions.name: "Heal Pulse"
definitions.description: "The user emits a healing pulse which restores the target's HP by 50%."

definitions.name: "Hex"
definitions.description: "The user places a curse on the target. If the target is debuffed or has a status condition, this move's base power is increased by 40."

definitions.name: "Volt Switch"
definitions.description: "After dealing damage, the user switches, increasing the combat readiness of a random ally to 100%."

definitions.name: "Bulldoze"
definitions.description: "The user stomps down on the ground and attacks everything in the area. This lowers the Speed of all targets for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Dragon Tail"
definitions.description: "The target is knocked away, reducing its combat readiness by 50%."

definitions.name: "Work Up"
definitions.description: "The user is roused, raising its Attack and Special Attack for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Electroweb"
definitions.description: "The user captures and attacks everything in the area with electricity. This lowers the Speed of targets for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Wild Charge"
definitions.description: "The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into the target, increasing base power by 20% of user's speed. This also damages the user by 25% of damage dealt."

definitions.name: "Drill Run"
definitions.description: "The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill."

definitions.name: "Razor Shell"
definitions.description: "The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This move has additional power proportional to the user's defense, and may also lower the target's Defense stat for 2 turns with a 50% chance."

definitions.name: "Psystrike"
definitions.description: "The user creates a powerful blast of psychic energy, dealing damage to the target and 50% damage to surrounding Pokemon. Uses the target's Defense stat."

definitions.name: "Divine Departure"
definitions.description: "The user slashes through the target at a blinding speed, dealing damage to the target and 50% damage to other Pokemon, increasing its combat readiness by 30% for each Pokemon defated. Uses the target's Defense stat."

definitions.name: "Hurricane"
definitions.description: "The user attacks by wrapping opponents in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This also has a 30% chance to leave targets confused for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Shadow Storm"
definitions.description: "The user attacks by wrapping opponents in fierce winds of corruption. If hit, always super effective. This also has a 30% chance to flinch targets."

definitions.name: "Sticky Web"
definitions.description: "The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stat and restricts them for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Fell Stinger"
definitions.description: "The user attacks the target with full force, sharply raising attack for 3 turns. If the target is knocked out, gain another turn."

definitions.name: "Noble Roar"
definitions.description: "The user roars loudly to intimidate the target, which lowers their attack and special attack for 1 turn. Ignores miss on the primary target."

definitions.name: "Freeze-Dry"
definitions.description: "The user rapidly cools the target with a 30% chance to freeze. Against water types, is super effective, ignores miss, with 100% chance to freeze."

definitions.name: "Petal Blizzard"
definitions.description: "The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it. Has 5 less base power for each additional target hit."

definitions.name: "Disarming Voice"
definitions.description: "The user attacks the target with a soothing voice, dealing damage with no chance to miss."

definitions.name: "Play Rough"
definitions.description: "The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target's attack and speed for 2 turns with a 70% chance."

definitions.name: "Moonblast"
definitions.description: "The user attacks the target with a moonblast. This also sharply lowers targets' special attack for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Boomburst"
definitions.description: "The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible, explosive sound. This user also sacrifices 50% of its remaining HP."

definitions.name: "Dazzling Gleam"
definitions.description: "The user damages the targets by emitting a powerful flash."

definitions.name: "Origin Pulse"
definitions.description: "The user summons a huge wave that crashes down on the opposing team. Increases the user's Special Attack and Special Defense for 1 turn BEFORE dealing damage."

definitions.name: "Precipice Blades"
definitions.description: "The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone. Increases the user's Attack and Defense for 1 turn BEFORE dealing damage."

definitions.name: "Dragon Ascent"
definitions.description: "The user soars upward with powerful wings and charges at the target at a steep angle. This calculates damage based off the lower of the targets' defense or special defense. Grants the user another turn but lowers its defenses for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Bolo Breath"
definitions.description: "The user launches a blast of fire from its mouth. This calculates damage based off the lower of the targets' defense or special defense. Then, heals the user 5% of its max HP for each target hit."

definitions.name: "Strength Sap"
definitions.description: "The user restores its HP by the same amount as the target's Attack stat. This also sharply lowers the target's Attack stat for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Toxic Thread"
definitions.description: "The user shoots poisonous threads to badly poison targets and lower their combat readiness by 100%."

definitions.name: "Liquidation"
definitions.description: "The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's defense stat for 3 turns with a 85% chance."

definitions.name: "10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt"
definitions.description: "The user unleashes a powerful beam of electricity. This ONLY deals damage to the primary target and 2 additional random enemies, but has a 20% chance to paralyze all targets."

definitions.name: "Double Iron Bash"
definitions.description: "The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This move hits twice; once in a row and once in a column, each with a 30% chance to flinch."

definitions.name: "Dual Wingbeat"
definitions.description: "The user slams targets with its wings. The primary target is hit twice in a row."

definitions.name: "Pound"
definitions.description: "The user pounds the target with its forelegs or tail."

definitions.name: "Democracy"
definitions.description: "The user votes for the primary target, causing it to gain 100% combat readiness and increased speed for 2 turns. All other enemies lose 30% combat readiness and have decreased speed for 1 turn. Ignores miss on the primary target."

definitions.name: "HM Master"
definitions.description: "The user sharply raises its attacking stats for 1 turn. The user then uses all available HM moves against the target. If the HM move is on cooldown, reset the cooldown instead of using the move."

definitions.name: "Rocket Thievery"
definitions.description: "The user attempts to steal a random fainted enemy Pokemon, reviving it with 50% HP. Fails if the enemy has no fainted Pokemon, or if the user's party has no empty positions."

definitions.name: "Time Dilation"
definitions.description: "The user distorts time, increasing ally speed for 2 turns and decreasing enemy speed for 2 turns. The user gains another turn."

definitions.name: "Stoke the Fire!"
definitions.description: "The user re-empowers its flames, healing itself for 40% HP and gaining another turn."

definitions.name: "Destructor Beam"
definitions.description: "The user fires a beam of dark energy at the target, dealing damage and dispelling all buffs."

definitions.name: "Scammed!"
definitions.description: "The user makes an unfair deal with the enemy team, increasing enemies' combat readiness by 10%, in exchange for increasing all ally combat readiness by 30%."

definitions.name: "All-In"
definitions.description: "The user goes all-in, sacrificing all its wealth, sharply reducing its defenses for 1 turn and reducing its health by 50%. In exchange, increases the duration of all ally buffs by 1 turn."

definitions.name: "King of Hell"
definitions.description: "The user lets its swords draw from its own power, then slices three times at the target. Successful hits deal an additional 10% of the target's max HP true damage. If the primary target is defeated, targets random enemies without missing."

definitions.name: "Gear Fifth"
definitions.description: "If under 25% HP, the user activates Gear Fifth, transforming into Sun God Infernape for 3 turns, then gives itself another turn and 50% HP. FAILS if the user is not under 25% HP."

definitions.name: "Dawn Rocket"
definitions.description: "The user bends the environment to propel itself through the opponent. Uses the minimum of the user and opponent's Special Defense to calculate damage."

definitions.name: "Monkey God Gun"
definitions.description: "The user inflates its fist to the size of an island, then crashes it down on the enemy team."

definitions.name: "ZA WATER!!!"
definitions.description: "The user activates its Stand, ZA WATER!!!, forcing time to stop for all other Pokemon. This provides the user a buff granting it 2 extra turns."

definitions.name: "Drizzle"
definitions.description: "At the start of battle, stir up a rainy storm."

definitions.name: "Speed Boost"
definitions.description: "At the end of each turn, increase the user's Combat Readiness by 20%, increasing by 20% each turn, up to a maximum of 60%."

definitions.name: "Sturdy"
definitions.description: "When taking fatal damage from full health, the user instead survives with 1 HP and gains invulnerability to direct damage for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Limber"
definitions.description: "Prevents the user from paralysis."

definitions.name: "Static"
definitions.description: "When the user takes damage and survives from a physical move, 50% chance to paralyze the attacker."

definitions.name: "Volt Absorb"
definitions.description: "When the user takes damage from an electric move, negate the damage and heal 25% of max HP."

definitions.name: "Water Absorb"
definitions.description: "When the user takes damage from a water move, negate the damage and heal 25% of max HP."

definitions.name: "Cloud Nine"
definitions.description: "Negates all weather effects."

definitions.name: "Compound Eyes"
definitions.description: "Increases accuracy of moves by 50%."

definitions.name: "Insomnia"
definitions.description: "Prevents the user from sleep."

definitions.name: "Flash Fire"
definitions.description: "When the user takes damage from a fire move, negate the damage grant Atk. Up and Spa. Up. for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Shield Dust"
definitions.description: "Prevents the user from being debuffed by dispellable debuffs."

definitions.name: "Own Tempo"
definitions.description: "Prevents the user from being confused."

definitions.name: "Intimidate"
definitions.description: "At the start of battle, lowers the attack of the enemy Pokemon with the highest attack and the enemy Pokemon with the highest speed for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Shadow Tag"
definitions.description: "At the start of battle, restrict all enemies for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Wonder Guard"
definitions.description: "The user has 75% less HP. The user takes no damage from non-supereffective moves."

definitions.name: "Levitate"
definitions.description: "The user evades Ground-type moves and effects."

definitions.name: "Effect Spore"
definitions.description: "When the user is damaged by a physical move, the Pokemon that hit the user has a 50% chance of being inflicted with Poison, Paralysis, or Sleep."

definitions.name: "Synchronize"
definitions.description: "When the user is inflicted with a status condition, the Pokemon that inflicted the status condition is also inflicted with the same status condition."

definitions.name: "Clear Body"
definitions.description: "The user cannot receive dispellable debuffs."

definitions.name: "Natural Cure"
definitions.description: "After the user targets an ally with a move, heal their status conditions. If the move is ULTIMATE, also dispell their debuffs."

definitions.name: "Lightning Rod"
definitions.description: "When the user is targeted by an Electric-type move, the move is redirected to the user. This also boosts user's special attack for 2 turns if dealt damage."

definitions.name: "Swift Swim"
definitions.description: "Increases user's speed by 1/3 of its level. Increases speed by 50% (multiplicative with initial buff) in rain."

definitions.name: "Chlorophyll"
definitions.description: "Increases user's speed by 1/3 of its level. Increases speed by 50% (multiplicative with initial buff) in harsh sunlight."

definitions.name: "Illuminate"
definitions.description: "At the start of battle, reduce the evasion of the enemy front row for 4 turns."

definitions.name: "Huge Power"
definitions.description: "Doubles user's attack (x)."

definitions.name: "Poison Point"
definitions.description: "When the user is damaged by a physical move, the move user has a 50% chance to be poisoned."

definitions.name: "Inner Focus"
definitions.description: "Prevents the user from flinching."

definitions.name: "Sand Stream"
definitions.description: "At the start of battle, kick up a Sandstorm."

definitions.name: "Pressure"
definitions.description: "When the user takes or deals damage, put a random available move for the target on cooldown for 2 turns, if it can have a cooldown. Can only be triggered once per-target."

definitions.name: "Conqueror's Pressure"
definitions.description: "When the user takes or deals damage from a move, attack the target with a physical attack with 30% the move's power, but use the targets Special Defense stat. Can only be triggered once per-target."

definitions.name: "Thick Fat"
definitions.description: "Reduces damage taken from fire and ice moves by 50%."

definitions.name: "Run Away"
definitions.description: "The first time this Pokemon's HP is reduced below 33%, increase its combat readiness to 100%."

definitions.name: "Hyper Cutter"
definitions.description: "Prevents the user's attack from being lowered by Atk. Down and Greater Atk. Down."

definitions.name: "Pickup"
definitions.description: "After an other ally loses a dispellable buff, have a 30% chance to gain that buff for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Truant"
definitions.description: "Skips every second turn."

definitions.name: "Old Age"
definitions.description: "Every second turn, sharply lower the user's speed for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Cute Charm"
definitions.description: "Before the user is hit by a physical move, there is a 50% chance to lower the attacker's attack for 1 turn."

definitions.name: "Guts"
definitions.description: "After being afflicted with a status condition, permanently boost the user's attack by 100%."

definitions.name: "Overgrow"
definitions.description: "Increases damage of grass moves by 50% when HP is below 1/2."

definitions.name: "Blaze"
definitions.description: "Increases damage of fire moves by 50% when HP is below 1/2."

definitions.name: "Torrent"
definitions.description: "Increases damage of water moves by 50% when HP is below 1/2."

definitions.name: "Swarm"
definitions.description: "Increases damage of bug moves by 50% when HP is below 1/2."

definitions.name: "Drought"
definitions.description: "At the start of battle, the weather becomes sunny."

definitions.name: "Arena Trap"
definitions.description: "Whenever the user damages a target, restrict their combat readiness boosts for 2 turns. Doesn't affect Pokemon in the air."

definitions.name: "Shell Armor"
definitions.description: "Reduces damage taken from moves by 12.5%."

definitions.name: "Air Lock"
definitions.description: "Negates all weather effects."

definitions.name: "Solar Power"
definitions.description: "Increases damage dealt by user by 35% when sunny."

definitions.name: "Sniper"
definitions.description: "Increases damage dealt by user to the BACKMOST row by 50%."

definitions.name: "No Guard"
definitions.description: "Moves used by and against the user never miss."

definitions.name: "Technician"
definitions.description: "Increases damage dealt by moves with 70 base power or less by 50%."

definitions.name: "Forewarn"
definitions.description: "The user takes 15% less damage from super effective and ultimate moves."

definitions.name: "Filter"
definitions.description: "The user takes 20% less damage from super effective moves."

definitions.name: "Storm Drain"
definitions.description: "When the user is targeted by a Water-type move, the move is redirected to the user. This also boosts user's special attack for 2 turns and ignores damage."

definitions.name: "Ice Body"
definitions.description: "After the user's turn, if it's hailing, heal 33% of its max HP."

definitions.name: "Sheer Force"
definitions.description: "Increases damage dealt by moves by 20%, but prevents the user from applying effects or status conditions."

definitions.name: "Cursed Body"
definitions.description: "When the user is damaged by a move, the move, increase its cooldown by 2."

definitions.name: "Heavy Metal"
definitions.description: "Increases damage of Steel moves by 8% of the user's defense."

definitions.name: "Multiscale"
definitions.description: "Reduces damage taken by 50% when HP is full."

definitions.name: "Poison Touch"
definitions.description: "When the user is damaged by a physical move, the move user has a 50% chance to be poisoned."

definitions.name: "Big Pecks"
definitions.description: "Immune to Def. Down and Greater Def. Down."

definitions.name: "Moxie"
definitions.description: "When the user defeats a Pokemon, gain increased attack for 2 turns and 20% combat readiness. If already has increased attack, greatly increase attack instead."

definitions.name: "Magic Bounce"
definitions.description: "Reflects non-damaging moves back to the user."

definitions.name: "Prankster"
definitions.description: "After using a non-damaging move, gain 30% combat readiness."

definitions.name: "Competitive"
definitions.description: "After receiving a debuff, sharply increase special attack for 3 turns."

definitions.name: "Stakeout"
definitions.description: "Allies deal 30% more damage to enemies with greater than 60% combat readiness."

definitions.name: "Mind Presence"
definitions.description: "Whenever an enemy ends a turn, increase the user's combat readiness by 10% attacking stats by 2% without triggering effects. The user cannot be damaged by more than 35% of its max HP at a time. The user is immune to instant-faint effects."

definitions.name: "Soul Body"
definitions.description: "Whenever the user survives damage, increase its combat readiness by 15% without triggering effects, and heal all allies by 5% of its max HP. The user cannot be damaged by more than 35% of its max HP at a time. The user is immune to instant-faint effects."

definitions.name: "Soul Energy"
definitions.description: "Whenever the user's turn ends, increase the combat readiness of all allies by 15% without triggering effects. The user cannot be damaged by more than 55% of its max HP at a time. The user is immune to instant-faint effects."

definitions.name: "Spirit Power"
definitions.description: "Whenever a Pokemon faints, permanently incease the user's attacking stats and speed by 20% without triggering effects. The user cannot be damaged by more than 55% of its max HP at a time. The user is immune to instant-faint effects."

definitions.name: "False Democracy"
definitions.description: "Whenever an enemy gains combat readiness, disable its ultimate move for 1 turn. This can only happen once per-enemy."

definitions.name: "Anarchy"
definitions.description: "Every other turn, the user enters Anarchy mode. This increases the user's speed by 100% (+), but decreases accuracy by 50% (+). Starts the battle in Anarchy mode."

definitions.name: "Bloody Sunday"
definitions.description: "Whenever an ally Pokemon faints, increase the user's combat readiness to 100% and heal 10% HP."

definitions.name: "Resurrection"
definitions.description: "The first time the user would take lethal damage, prevent it and set its combat readiness to 100%."

definitions.name: "Royalty"
definitions.description: "Boosts the user's Special Attack by 30% of its starting Attack."

definitions.name: "Money Bags"
definitions.description: "At the start of the battle, the user gains the Money Bags buff, which heals allies when taking damage."

definitions.name: "Ever-beating Heart"
definitions.description: "At the start of battle, the user gets Immortality for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Blue Haki"
definitions.description: "The user's buffs last 1 additional turn. When buffed, the user deals 25% more damage."

definitions.name: "Armored Behemoth's Pressure"
definitions.description: "The user is immune to instant-faint effects and takes reduced damage. When taking damage, increase the user's defensive stats by 5% and has a 30% chance to counter with a random move."

definitions.name: "Shadow Berserker's Rage"
definitions.description: "The user is immune to instant-faint effects and takes reduced damage. When taking damage, increase the user's offensive stats by 5% and gains 30% combat readiness."

definitions.name: "Cosmic Strength"
definitions.description: "When the user receives an attack debuff, sharply raise the other attacking stat for 2 turns."

definitions.name: "Cosmic Protection"
definitions.description: "Reduce the damage taken by all allies except the user by 10%."

definitions.name: "Cosmic Agility"
definitions.description: "When the user starts its turn, boost the stats of all allies permanently by 2%. Can occur up to 10 times."

definitions.description: "The target's Attack greatly increased."

definitions.name: "Atk. Down"
definitions.description: "The target's Attack decreased."

definitions.name: "Greater Atk. Down"
definitions.description: "The target's Attack greatly decreased."

definitions.description: "The target's Defense increased."

definitions.description: "The target's Defense sharply increased."

definitions.description: "The target's Defense decreased."

definitions.description: "The target's Defense sharply decreased."

definitions.description: "The target's Special Attack increased."

definitions.description: "The target's Special Attack sharply increased."

definitions.name: "Sp. Atk. Down"
definitions.description: "The target's Special Attack decreased."

definitions.name: "Greater Sp. Atk. Down"
definitions.description: "The target's Special Attack sharply decreased."

definitions.name: "Sp. Def. Up"
definitions.description: "The target's Special Defense increased."

definitions.name: "Greater Sp. Def. Up"
definitions.description: "The target's Special Defense sharply increased."

definitions.name: "Sp. Def. Down"
definitions.description: "The target's Special Defense decreased."

definitions.name: "Greater Sp. Def. Down"
definitions.description: "The target's Special Defense sharply decreased."

definitions.description: "The target's Speed increased."

definitions.description: "The target's Speed sharply increased."

definitions.description: "The target's Speed decreased."

definitions.name: "Greater Spe. Down"
definitions.description: "The target's Speed sharply decreased."

definitions.name: "Acc. Down"
definitions.description: "The target's Accuracy decreased."

definitions.name: "Greater Acc. Down"
definitions.description: "The target's Accuracy sharply decreased."

definitions.name: "Eva. Up"
definitions.description: "The target's Evasion increased."

definitions.name: "Greater Eva. Up"
definitions.description: "The target's Evasion sharply increased."

definitions.name: "Eva. Down"
definitions.description: "The target's Evasion decreased."

definitions.name: "Greater Eva. Down"
definitions.description: "The target's Evasion sharply decreased."

definitions.name: "Confused"
definitions.description: "The target is confused."

definitions.name: "Counter"
definitions.description: "The target will counter physical moves used against it."

definitions.name: "Mirror Coat"

definitions.name: "Welcome to Pokestar!"
definitions.description: `Welcome to Pokestar! Pokestar is a battle-focused Pokemon Discord bot! This tutorial will guide you through the basics of Pokestar. **For more information, please [join the support server](${SUPPORT_SERVER_INVITE}) or use \`/help\` for help with commands!**`

definitions.name: "Getting Started"
definitions.description: "To get started, take a look at your profile and items. **Use `/trainerinfo` and `/backpack`** to find all the information you need about your trainer."

definitions.name: "Catching Pokemon"
definitions.description: "**To catch new Pokemon, use the `/gacha` command**. The gacha costs Pokeballs, with rare Pokeballs catching rarer Pokemon. I would recommend using 10 Pokeballs on the standard banner."

definitions.name: "Pokemon Info"
definitions.description: "To view your Pokemon, use `/list`. You can also use `/info <pokemonId>` to view more information about a specific Pokemon."

definitions.name: "Upgrading Pokemon"
definitions.description: "**Use `/train <pokemonId>` to level up your Pokemon.** You can also train at a location (discussed later) for fast EXP training or EV training.\n\nOnce you've progressed more, use `/evolve` and `/equipment` to power-up your Pokemon even more."

definitions.name: "Pokeballs"
definitions.description: "The two easiest ways to get more Pokeballs are **`/daily` and `/vote`.** You can claim daily rewards once a day, and vote on each site twice a day."

definitions.name: "Progression"
definitions.description: "Both **money and trainer experience** are passively gained while playing. Levelling up your trainer makes your Pokemon gain more experience and allows you to claim level rewards. **Use `/levelrewards` to claim rewards for leveling up.**"

definitions.name: "Money"
definitions.description: "Money is used to buy items from the PokeMart. **Use `/pokemart` to view the PokeMart.** Items include Pokeballs, upgrade materials, and locations. **Locations are used to EV train Pokemon or get EXP faster.**"

definitions.name: "Party"
definitions.description: "Your party is the Pokemon you use in battle. **Use `/party manage` to manage your party.** In Pokestar, party position matters! Put tanky Pokemon in the front, and spread your Pokemon out to avoid AoE damage.\n\n**Alternatively, use `/partyauto` to automatically fill your party with your strongest Pokemon.**"

definitions.name: "Battle"
definitions.description:
"There are multiple battle types in Pokestar. The two most basic ones are `/pve` and `/pvp`. 

**PvE** battles are against NPCs. PvE is a great way of gaining Pokemon EXP and learning the battle mechanics.

**PvP** battles are friendly challenges against other players. Get some friends and see how well you stack up against each other!"

definitions.name: "Battle Mechanics"
definitions.description: "The Pokestar battle mechanics tries to adapt the mechanics from the original game with RPG gacha style mechanics from games such as Epic 7 and Summoners War. The mechanics are a bit complicated, so **if you want to learn more, [visit this page](https://github.com/ewei068/pokestar#-battle-mechanics).**\n\nThe most important mechanic to understand is how to move. **When it's your turn, use the selection menu to select a move. Then, use the bottom selection menu to select a target.**"

definitions.name: "Tutorial Complete!"
definitions.description: `Congratulations! You've completed the basic tutorial! **If you'd like to learn more, please [join the support server](${SUPPORT_SERVER_INVITE}) or use \`/help\` for help with commands!** Thank you for using Pokestar, and we hope you enjoy your experience!`
